name: gmail_reply
description: Replies inside a conversation of the last gmail_inbox list, from the same mailbox, optionally attaching one file from the workspace; the recipients get it at once. Use it only after showing the user the exact text (and the file, if any) and getting a yes. It needs the number from that list. It does not start new conversations (that is gmail_send). Files outside the workspace are refused. Never call it twice for the same reply. Returns one line confirming the reply.

number.description: Number of the conversation in the last gmail_inbox list (e.g. 2).

message.description: The exact reply the user approved, with nothing added (e.g. "Hi Clara, the quote is attached.").

attachment.description: Full path of one file to attach, inside the workspace (e.g. a file gmail_read saved). Leave it out for no attachment.

examples.message: Hi Clara, the quote is attached.
